d:
Benny Dayal & Shweta Pandit sing ‘Oru Kan Jaadai’ from Anjaan featuring Suriya & Samantha. The fast paced love number is great mix of melody and dance. Viveka writes charming lyrics for this song that perfectly captures that moment of love when even the bold & roaring Raju Bhai is unable to stay without lady love, Jeeva.
Song Name - Oru Kan Jaadai
Movie - Anjaan
Singer - Benny Dayal & Shweta Pandit
Music - Yuvanshankar Raja
Videos - Viveka
Director - N. Linguswamy
Starring - Suriya, Samantha
